reason: Hypothesis A directly addresses the research question by proposing a compositional change (Mn substitution) to increase coercivity in a FeCoNi-based high-entropy alloy, with a physically sound mechanism (antiferromagnetic coupling and lattice strain) and a clear, testable experiment. Hypothesis B, while well-supported, does not meet the constraint of a 'single intervention' to produce a qualifying high-entropy alloy, as it modifies processing rather than composition and uses the base FeCoNi alloy which may not meet the configurational entropy requirement.
